title: Add MyEntMap to chat
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [MyEntMap](https://mymap.qvlit.com) to chat
- MyEntMap is a multilingual (zh/vi/en, auto-detected) food & entertainment map for Ho Chi Minh City. It uses the Pollinations API in three ways: (1) auto-generating Ghibli-watercolor store photos with 

Fixes #12694

gist.headline: Map, snack, pollinate
gist.blurb: MyEntMap joined the garden: a multilingual Ho Chi Minh City food and entertainment map with Pollinations-powered Ghibli-watercolor storefronts. Finding a good meal now has a little more atmosphere.
gist.summary: Added MyEntMap to the community app directory, a Ho Chi Minh City food and entertainment map that auto-detects Chinese, Vietnamese, or English and uses the Pollinations API to generate Ghibli-watercolor store photos.
gist.impact: People exploring Ho Chi Minh City can discover food and entertainment in their language with AI-generated watercolor visuals for listed places.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy illustrated Ho Chi Minh City neighborhood map unfolding across a café table, with tiny restaurant storefronts represented as watercolor-like pixel postcards and map pins among potted flowers. Polli, wearing a tiny travel beret and holding a map, helps a friendly visitor navigate; include language markers for zh, vi, and en plus a lime-green route connecting food and entertainment spots.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art scene of a Ho Chi Minh City food-and-entertainment map spread across a warm café table, dotted with tiny Ghibli-watercolor-style storefront postcards, flower-filled map pins, and a bold lime green (#ecf874) route linking places marked “zh · vi · en.” The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny travel beret and warmly points at the map beside code-plants and a retro terminal. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle CRT glow, emotionally warm and nostalgic.
